summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return with The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, reporting a share buyback on Nasdaq. On April 30, 2026, the issuer repurchased 270,000 shares at USD 2.4967 per share, representing 0.0284% of existing issued shares, which were held as treasury shares. The closing balance of issued shares fell to 949,965,002 with 22,543,039 treasury shares. The repurchase was board-authorized and compliant with listing rules. This is a routine open-market buyback, not a tender offer. Watch for continued capital return activity; minimal near-term arb impact due to small size.
